summary: Delivered M5A of the battery testnet track: battery research and submission through Carbon's shared MCP interface. A Challenge registry (carbon/challenge_registry) resolves an exact id, version and execution profile or refuses with a typed code; there is no default and no Burgers fallback. Battery and Burgers are implemented; chip cooling, electric motors and photonics are reserved with their tracking issues; power magnetics and airfoils are deferred. Open-tier MCP tools list and describe every Challenge from its executable registrations, separating implemented from usable on this host. One B-07 composition now serves every Challenge through the same twelve operations, and the Burgers composition digests are unchanged. The battery adapter supplies authored practice contracts, public TRAIN/PRACTICE/OCV material, and practice in the isolated carrier from the exact Carbon recipe bytes, scored by Carbon with the exam's gates. A launch binds its Challenge in the frozen manifest; prepare, attach, freeze and submit route by it; a battery gateway authenticates battery requests only. Submission reaches an operator-configured evaluation deployment over committed private batches, with allow-listed feedback and typed REFUSED/FAILED_INFRA outcomes. Stated limits: the rebuild runs in the evaluation process (validator_path false) until M3; battery campaigns are miner-driven. No threshold, chain action, spend or qualification changes.
